content: Viramune XR is the brand name for the extended-release formulation of nevirapine, which is administered in tablet form. Nevirapine is classified as a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) and is specifically active against Human Immunodeficiency Virus Type 1 (HIV-1). Structurally, nevirapine belongs to the dipyridodiazepinone chemical class of compounds. The chemical name of nevirapine is 11-cyclopropyl-5,11-dihydro-4-methyl-6H-dipyrido[3,2-b:2',3'-e][1,4]diazepin-6-one, and its molecular formula is C15H14N4O. The structural formula of nevirapine is as follows (not depicted here). Viramune XR tablets are intended for oral administration. Each tablet contains either 100 mg or 400 mg of nevirapine as the active ingredient. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include lactose monohydrate, hypromellose, iron oxide, and magnesium stearate.
